connector.name: FormBro
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for FormBro Canadian immigration application automation.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.formbro.ca over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package formbro-mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jackyzhang69 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
